mon_mammoth_idle.brief: an enormous woolly beast breathing deep and slow, a faint low rumble

mon_mammoth_attack.brief: an enormous beast slamming its tusks forward with a trumpeting roar

level_up_hymn.brief: low men's voices holding one solemn note, then opening upward together into a bright wide chord in a stone cathedral

cross_on_twigmat.brief: a mat of small dry twigs lifting and crackling faintly, gentle not sharp
